release_note_review.reason: Research 422 stopped headless because user, project, and local settings stay enabled. Response-only passes --safe-mode. Same safe-mode boundary. Response-only does not select Stop hook stream events; unknown event types still fail closed, and the route does not pass --include-hook-events.
Research 378 already excludes context:fork slash-skill streaming because --disable-slash-commands is set. That flag remains in the binary.
Release notes add onFailure block for command and HTTP hooks. The routes do not set it. Marker onFailure remains present. Default hook decisions are not described as changed.
The fix is text output. Both routes select stream-json. The stream-json help lines stay byte-identical.

Built-in tools that register after launch now honor --tools. Headless already sends Read,Glob,Grep. Response-only already sends an empty tool list. Help text still says an empty list disables all tools.

Async hook JSON printed over several lines is now applied. This does not change stream-json required fields or the v2 rules that a deny blocks, a rewrite is rechecked, and Stop reentry uses stop_hook_active.

The note is a background session leaving safe mode on wake or restart. Response-only disables session persistence and is one shot. Headless does not pass --safe-mode.
The flag is present from 2.1.295 onward. Neither route passes it. Input format help still offers text or stream-json.

claude -p with no permission mode starts in default on third-party providers, with telemetry off, or on a fresh install. Headless passes --permission-mode plan. Response-only already requires init permissionMode default.

subagent_type fork is on by default in claude -p unless CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0. Headless v2 already accepts non-final parent_tool_use_id frames. The Agent tool is not in Read,Glob,Grep. Response-only rejects a non-null parent_tool_use_id and passes an empty tool list plus --disable-slash-commands, so the model cannot start that subagent or a slash fork skill.
